summary_en: TSURUMI MANUFACTURING approved acquisition of up to 1.2 million shares (2.51% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 2.6 billion yen from November 13, 2026 through May 11, 2027 via ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases. Separately, the company will cancel 570,000 shares (1.19% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) on November 20, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On November 12, 2026, TSURUMI MANUFACTURING's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury stock and cancel existing treasury stock based on provisions of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 1.2 million ordinary shares for a maximum total of 2.6 billion yen from November 13, 2026 through May 11, 2027, representing 2.51% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition will be conducted through two methods: (1) off-exchange transactions via ToSTNeT-3 market purchases and (2) market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Separately, the company will cancel 570,000 ordinary shares on November 20, 2026, reducing the number of issued shares excluding treasury stock from 47,864,238 to 50,256,972 shares. This cancellation represents 1.19% of issued shares excluding treasury stock prior to cancellation. The stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and execute flexible capital policies in response to changing business environments. The company also announced a policy to maintain treasury stock holdings at no more than 5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, with excess shares to be cancelled promptly.
